verdict.rationale: TypeSafe's own models page offers zero data retention (ZDR) for enterprise customers and points to a DPA and Privacy Policy. That is a first-party retention option, but it is enterprise-gated and only mentioned in passing. The no-training statement is related but does not address retention or deletion control. Missing for 10: self-serve retention settings for non-enterprise users, documented deletion mechanisms (API or console) for stored requests and responses, stated default retention periods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
